scripts.speaker: Blacksmith
scripts.text: You've never heard of me? Why, I'm the Veteran Blacksmith of this land. I've spent 30 years in this hot and bloody hellfire, bending steel to my iron will!

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith
scripts.text:
But...
I am growing older and my prowess begins to fade with age. So I've invented something for young, hot, upcoming Blacksmiths, in hopes that they too will master my craft...
What is it?

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith
scripts.text: We Blacksmiths must always manipulate steel under extreme heat, and the hot air and melted metals are more than most people can stand.

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith
scripts.text: For the sake of our craft, our beautiful, yet masculine faces are put at risk...

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith
scripts.text: But with this wonder of technology, there's no need to worry! Behold, the ^3355FFWelding Mask^000000 !!

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith
scripts.text: It works by covering your face with a fat metal plate. Truly, it's an item that everyone should want! If not yourself, it'd be a good idea to give this to a friend who is studying smithing.

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith
scripts.text: So how about it ? If you give me ^2244FF50 Steel^000000 and ^4422FFonly 2000 Zeny^000000, I will make it for you right away~!!
Hm... Not bad. Alright.
How does it work again?

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith
scripts.text: Ah, I see that you appreciate a Blacksmith's work! Alright, I'll do it right away !!

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith
scripts.text: Hahaha~! Make good use of that!

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith
scripts.text:
Hmmm...
You do not have the items I require.

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith
scripts.text: A common Blacksmith would interpret this as a sign of disrepect, but I will forgive you. Just don't forget what I need if you want me to make you this mask.

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith
scripts.text: The ^3355FFWelding Mask^000000 protects your face by covering it with a fat metal plate. This invention is the result of 30 years of endless toil at the hammer and anvil.

scripts.speaker: Blacksmith
scripts.text:
Ah...!
I guess this is the first time you've met a Blacksmith as great as me, and you're just speechless with awe. Please, take your time and speak up when you are ready.

a little full
of himself.^000000

scripts.speaker: Eric
scripts.text: My Grandfather, who passed away a few years ago, was special to me. He always stayed with me, and took care of me. He was much better than my old man, who was always busy working.

scripts.speaker: Eric
scripts.text: To me, Grandfather's library was always like a fantasy land where I could escape. I spent most of my time there.

scripts.speaker: Eric
scripts.text: I learned a lot of things from his books in the Library. Grandfather was interested in Alchemy and Music, and his Library was filled with many mysterious old books.

scripts.speaker: Eric
scripts.text:
One day...
As usual, I went to the Library and discovered an interesting schematic.

scripts.speaker: Eric
scripts.text: It showed some instrument which looked like Ear Muffs that, when worn on the head, could transmit music or whispers to the ears through a thin wire.

scripts.speaker: Eric
scripts.text:
I guess...
It is my grand father's unfinished work. I met a few Alchemists and asked them to produce it, but they rejected my offer...

scripts.speaker: Eric
scripts.text: In the end, I thought 'I've gotta make it myself.' So I researched for a few years, and now I fully understand how to make that thing. But, I could never gather the materials to make it!

scripts.speaker: Eric
scripts.text: If I can get those articles, I would build it right away. If you are interested in my idea, would you bring them for me?

scripts.speaker: Eric
scripts.text: All I wanna do is build this thing in honor of my grandfather and finish the work he started. If you ask me to keep it, I wouldn't mind.

scripts.speaker: Eric
scripts.text:
40 ^3355FFSteel^000000
1 ^3355FFOridecon^000000
1 ^3355FFAlcohol^000000
1 ^3355FFCoal^000000
These are the things I need for Grandfather's masterpiece.
*Tap! Tap! Tap!*

scripts.speaker: Eric
scripts.text:
Thank you.
Because of you, I could accomplish my grandfather's wish. He would be happy if he looked down on me from Heaven.

scripts.speaker: Eric
scripts.text: As I said, please take this. I am just proud that I can make this by myself.

scripts.speaker: Eric
scripts.text: Thank you for trying to help me, but you didn't bring all the items I need. I think you will find them all soon though.

scripts.speaker: Eric
scripts.text:
N-no?
Well...
You have your own
worries, I suppose.
Farewell.

scripts.speaker: Nia
scripts.text:
Ah, well, the objective of
the Number Match game is to
guess the number I'm thinking
of. Of course, there are a few
rules that limit the numbers
that I can choose from.

scripts.speaker: Nia
scripts.text:
All the numbers that I make
up must be 3 digits, I can't
use 0 for any of the digits,
and I can't use the same
number for any of the digits
more than once.

scripts.speaker: Nia
scripts.text:
So, for example, I can't
use the numbers 103, 112,
252, or 701. Those numbers
either have a 0, or they use
the same number in the digits
more than once. Got it now?

scripts.speaker: Nia
scripts.text:
Now, you only get 5 guesses,
and after each guess, I'll tell
you how many digits you guessed
correctly, followed by the number of correctly guessed digits in
the correct digit place.

scripts.speaker: Nia
scripts.text:
For example, let's say the
number I come up with is 168.
If your first guess is 678, then you guessed two of the digits,
6 and 8, correctly. However,
only 8 is in the correct place.

scripts.speaker: Nia
scripts.text:
You know, it'd be a good idea
if you try the Practice Mode
first. Then, when you're more
comfortable, play the actual
Number Match game. Don't forget that speed counts for your score!

scripts.speaker: Nia
scripts.text:
Ah, if you happen to
make a new record in the
Number Match game, you'll
have your name recorded,
so don't miss this chance for
fame and maybe even fortune~
